name: S.M. Gold Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2017, S. M. Gold Ltd is in 
the business of Gold, Diamond & Jewellery Ornaments[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SMGL is in the business of manufacturing and wholesale trading of mangalsutra jewellery, and in small parts for other jewellery. The company offers customers a wide variety of traditional, indo-western and modern jewellery. They also customize the jewellery as per the individual needs. It is sold under the brand name S. M. Gold - the House of Mangalsutra

pros: Stock is trading at 0.75 times its book value
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 89.0 days to 69.1 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 1.71% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -10.8%
